import {test,beforeEach,afterEach}from'node:test';import assert from'node:assert/strict';import{randomUUID as uid,createHash}from'node:crypto';import{readFile,writeFile}from'node:fs/promises';
import{isolatedDeposit,write}from'../support/h4-deposit-isolated.ts';import{allocationFixture}from'../support/h3-allocation-fixtures.ts';import{refundFixture}from'../support/h4-refund-fixtures.ts';import{depositFixture}from'../support/h4-deposit-fixtures.ts';import{f06Migration}from'../support/h4-019-current-chain.ts';import{H0005PostgresAdapter}from'../../src/infrastructure/postgres/h0-005-adapter.ts';import{verifyAuth}from'../../src/application/verified-auth.ts';
let h:Awaited<ReturnType<typeof isolatedDeposit>>;beforeEach(async()=>{h=await isolatedDeposit('crm_f06_authority',57210);await h.migration.unsafe(await readFile('supabase/migrations/'+f06Migration,'utf8'));});afterEach(async()=>{await h?.close();});
const pause=(n:number)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,n));
const auth=(sessionId?:string)=>verifyAuth({verify:async()=>({subject:h.subject,sessionId,passwordVerified:true,mfaVerified:true})},uid());
async function second(){const db=h.connect('crm_h0_runtime'),api=new H0005PostgresAdapter(db,h.f1,h.f2),s=await api.establish(await auth());return{db,api,...s,auth:await auth(s.sessionId)};}
async function barrier(){const db=h.connect('crm_h0_migration');await db.unsafe('begin');return{db,pid:Number((await db`select pg_backend_pid() p`)[0]!.p)};}
async function waiting(count:number){let rows:any[]=[];for(let n=0;n<300;n++){rows=await h.admin`select pid,backend_xid::text xid,usename,wait_event,pg_blocking_pids(pid) blockers,query from pg_stat_activity where wait_event_type='Lock' order by query_start`;if(rows.length>=count)break;await pause(10);}assert.equal(rows.length,count);const locks=await h.admin`select pid,locktype,relation::regclass::text relation,mode,granted,transactionid::text,classid::text,objid::text,objsubid,page,tuple from pg_locks where pid=any(${rows.map(x=>Number(x.pid))}) order by pid,locktype,granted`;console.log('F06 AUTHORITY WAIT',JSON.stringify({rows,locks}));return rows;}
for(const mutation of['disable','revokeOne','revokeAll','reidentify','establish']as const)test('A04 admitted first: '+mutation+' waits for two admitted economic units',async()=>{
 const b=await second(),c=await second(),a=await allocationFixture(h,'100.00','100.00','verified','900.00'),q=await a.assign('20.00'),r=await a.assign('20.00','20.00'),hold=await barrier();
 await hold.db`select pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(${'payment-root:'+a.paymentId},0))`;
 const p=h.allocations.apply(b.auth,write,q).then(v=>({ok:true,v}),e=>({ok:false,e:String(e)}));await waiting(1);
 const z=h.allocations.apply(c.auth,write,r).then(v=>({ok:true,v}),e=>({ok:false,e:String(e)}));const admitted=await waiting(2);assert.ok(admitted.every(x=>x.wait_event==='advisory'));
 const generation=String((await h.admin`select access_generation g from crm_private.crm_actors`)[0]!.g);
 const change=mutation==='disable'?h.migration`select crm_api.set_actor_enabled(${h.actorId}::uuid,false,'ready')`:mutation==='revokeOne'?b.api.revokeOne(b.auth):mutation==='revokeAll'?b.api.revokeAll(b.auth):mutation==='reidentify'?b.api.reidentify(b.auth):b.api.establish(await auth());
 let finished=false;const done=change.then(v=>{finished=true;return v;});
 try{const rows=await waiting(3);assert.equal(finished,false);assert.ok(rows.at(-1)!.blockers.some((pid:number)=>admitted.some(x=>Number(x.pid)===pid)),'authority change waits for admitted actor SHARE');await hold.db.unsafe('rollback');const outcomes=await Promise.all([p,z]);assert.equal(outcomes.filter(x=>x.ok).length,1);await done;
 if(mutation==='disable'||mutation==='revokeOne'||mutation==='revokeAll')await assert.rejects(h.allocations.read(b.auth, (await import('../support/h4-deposit-isolated.ts')).read,a.paymentId));
 if(mutation==='revokeAll'){assert.equal(BigInt(String((await h.admin`select access_generation g from crm_private.crm_actors`)[0]!.g)),BigInt(generation)+1n);const fresh=(await new H0005PostgresAdapter(h.runtime,h.f1,h.f2).establish(await auth())).sessionId;h.sessionId=fresh;h.auth=()=>auth(fresh);}
 }finally{await hold.db.unsafe('rollback');await Promise.allSettled([p,z,done]);if(mutation==='disable')await h.migration`select crm_api.set_actor_enabled(${h.actorId}::uuid,true,'ready')`;await hold.db.end();}
});
test('A02 same session still exclusive after compatible actor admission',async()=>{
 const b=await second(),a=await allocationFixture(h,'100.00','100.00'),q=await a.assign('20.00'),r=await a.assign('20.00','20.00'),hold=await barrier();await hold.db`select pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(${'payment-root:'+a.paymentId},0))`;
 const p=h.allocations.apply(b.auth,write,q).then(v=>({ok:true,v}),e=>({ok:false,e:String(e)}));await waiting(1);const z=h.allocations.apply(b.auth,write,r).then(v=>({ok:true,v}),e=>({ok:false,e:String(e)}));try{const rows=await waiting(2);assert.equal(rows[0]!.wait_event,'advisory');assert.equal(rows[1]!.wait_event,'transactionid');await hold.db.unsafe('rollback');assert.equal((await Promise.all([p,z])).filter(x=>x.ok).length,1);}finally{await hold.db.unsafe('rollback');await Promise.allSettled([p,z]);await hold.db.end();}
});
for(const mutation of['disable','revokeOne','revokeAll']as const)test('A03 '+mutation+' first denies later access without activity reactivation',async()=>{
 const b=await second(),a=await allocationFixture(h,'100.00','100.00'),q=await a.assign('20.00');const before=(await h.admin`select last_human_activity_at from crm_private.identification_epochs where epoch_id=${b.epochId}::uuid`)[0]!.last_human_activity_at;
 try{if(mutation==='disable')await h.migration`select crm_api.set_actor_enabled(${h.actorId}::uuid,false,'ready')`;else if(mutation==='revokeOne')await b.api.revokeOne(b.auth);else await b.api.revokeAll(b.auth);
 await assert.rejects(h.allocations.apply(b.auth,write,q));assert.deepEqual((await h.admin`select last_human_activity_at from crm_private.identification_epochs where epoch_id=${b.epochId}::uuid`)[0]!.last_human_activity_at,before);
 }finally{if(mutation==='disable')await h.migration`select crm_api.set_actor_enabled(${h.actorId}::uuid,true,'ready')`;if(mutation==='revokeAll'){const fresh=(await new H0005PostgresAdapter(h.runtime,h.f1,h.f2).establish(await auth())).sessionId;h.sessionId=fresh;h.auth=()=>auth(fresh);}}
});
test('A05 mapping cannot be replaced; authority mutation locks remain exclusive; one body changed',async()=>{
 await assert.rejects(h.migration`select crm_api.provision_actor_mapping(${h.actorId}::uuid,${uid()}::uuid,${h.scope})`);
 const defs=await h.observer`select p.oid::regprocedure::text signature,pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) body from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='crm_api' and p.proname in('revoke_session','reidentify_session','establish_session','revoke_all_sessions','set_actor_enabled','provision_actor_mapping','recovery_begin','recovery_complete') order by 1`;
 assert.ok(defs.filter(x=>['revoke_session','reidentify_session','establish_session','revoke_all_sessions'].some(n=>x.signature.includes(n))).every(x=>x.body.includes('for update')));console.log('F06 audited authority function bodies',JSON.stringify(defs));
});
const hash=(s:string)=>createHash('sha256').update(s).digest('hex');
test('A10 V-MIG upgrade48 populated, injected DDL rollback retry, exact data/catalog except admit body',async()=>{
 const g=await isolatedDeposit('crm_f06_upgrade',57211);try{
 const f=await refundFixture(g);await f.run(await f.determine());await(await f.approval(await f.authorization())).execute();await f.run(await f.movement('20.00'));const inc=await f.incident();await f.run(await f.command('uncertain',{attempt:{id:uid(),sourceRef:'SYNTHETIC original reserve60',portion:await f.portion('60.00','20.00')},incidentId:inc.incidentId}));const d=await depositFixture(g);await d.initialize();await d.run(await d.delivery());await d.run(await d.evaluate());await(await d.approval(await d.determination())).execute();await d.run(await d.fact('retain','20.00','0.00'));await d.run(await d.fact('return','30.00','20.00'));
 const catalog=async()=>({functions:await g.observer`select p.oid,p.oid::regprocedure::text signature,p.proowner,p.proacl,p.proconfig,p.proargtypes::text,p.prorettype,p.provolatile,p.proparallel,p.prosecdef,p.proisstrict,pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) body from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname like 'crm_%' order by p.oid`,relations:await g.observer`select c.oid,relname,relowner,relacl,relrowsecurity,relforcerowsecurity from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname like 'crm_%' order by c.oid`,policies:await g.observer`select * from pg_policy order by oid`,triggers:await g.observer`select oid,tgrelid,tgname,tgfoid,tgtype,tgenabled from pg_trigger order by oid`,roles:await g.observer`select rolname,rolsuper,rolbypassrls,rolinherit,rolcreaterole,rolcreatedb from pg_roles order by rolname`,members:await g.observer`select * from pg_auth_members order by oid`});
 const names=(await g.observer`select tablename from pg_tables where schemaname='crm_private'order by tablename`).map(x=>String(x.tablename));const snapshot=async()=>Object.fromEntries(await Promise.all(names.map(async n=>[n,hash(JSON.stringify(await g.observer.unsafe(`select to_jsonb(x)::text v from crm_private.${n} x order by to_jsonb(x)::text`)))])));
 const data=await snapshot(),prior=await catalog(),sql=await readFile('supabase/migrations/'+f06Migration,'utf8');
 await g.admin.unsafe("create function public.f06_ddl_fail() returns event_trigger language plpgsql as $$begin raise exception 'SYNTHETIC_F06_DDL';end$$;create event trigger f06_ddl_fail on ddl_command_end when tag in('CREATE FUNCTION')execute function public.f06_ddl_fail()");
 await assert.rejects(g.migration.unsafe(sql),/SYNTHETIC_F06_DDL/);await g.migration.unsafe('rollback');await g.admin.unsafe('drop event trigger f06_ddl_fail;drop function public.f06_ddl_fail()');assert.deepEqual(await catalog(),prior);assert.deepEqual(await snapshot(),data);
 await assert.rejects(g.runtime.unsafe(sql));await g.runtime.unsafe('rollback');await g.migration.unsafe(sql);const current=await catalog();
 const changes=current.functions.filter((x,i)=>x.body!==prior.functions[i]!.body);assert.equal(changes.length,1);assert.equal(changes[0]!.signature,'crm_f2.admit(bytea,bytea,bytea,text,text)');
 const old=prior.functions.find(x=>x.signature===changes[0]!.signature)!;assert.equal(changes[0]!.body,old.body.replace('where actor_id=f[12]::uuid for update;','where actor_id=f[12]::uuid for share;'));
 assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify({...current,functions:current.functions.map(x=>({...x,body:prior.functions.find(y=>y.oid===x.oid)!.body}))})),JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(prior)));assert.deepEqual(await snapshot(),data);
 assert.equal((await f.view()).executed,'20.00');assert.equal((await f.view()).uncertain,'60.00');assert.equal((await d.view()).amounts.returned,'30.00');
 const report={fresh49CoveredByCurrentAuthority:true,upgrade48:true,ddlRollbackRetry:true,dataHashes:data,changedBody:changes[0],previousBody:old,preservedCatalog:true};console.log('F06 V-MIG',JSON.stringify(report));if(process.env.H4014_CAPTURE_DIR)await writeFile(process.env.H4014_CAPTURE_DIR+'/f06-preservation.json',JSON.stringify({report,prior,current},null,2)+'\n');
 }finally{await g.close();}
});
import {spawnSync}from'node:child_process';
test('A11 base48 migrations all expected approved sources dependencies health byte exact',async()=>{
 const base='f8318fad8bf8a7b6d8224330dc1b8840288dba60';const list=spawnSync('git',['ls-tree','-r','--name-only',base],{encoding:'utf8',maxBuffer:32*1024*1024});assert.equal(list.status,0);
 const paths=list.stdout.split('\n').filter(p=>p.startsWith('supabase/migrations/')||/\/expected-.*\.md$/.test(p)||['package.json','pnpm-lock.yaml','docs/constitution.md','docs/product.md','docs/business-rules.md','docs/domain-model.md','docs/state-machines.md','docs/architecture.md','docs/DECISIONS.md','specs/001-core-crm/spec.md','specs/001-core-crm/plan.md','supabase/operations/20261002225221_crm_supabase_daily_health.sql','tests/operations/supabase-health.test.mjs','docs/SUPABASE-KEEPALIVE.md'].includes(p));assert.equal(paths.filter(p=>p.startsWith('supabase/migrations/')).length,48);
 const manifest:Record<string,string>={};for(const p of paths){const old=spawnSync('git',['show',base+':'+p]);assert.equal(old.status,0);const bytes=await readFile(p);assert.deepEqual(bytes,old.stdout,p);manifest[p]=createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex');}
 const expected='specs/001-core-crm/expected-TSK-H4-019-F06.md';assert.deepEqual(await readFile(expected),spawnSync('git',['show','6c1f060a560e28e513e87f186e16a54911a1a444:'+expected]).stdout);manifest[expected]=hash(await readFile(expected,'utf8'));console.log('F06 exact immutable manifest',JSON.stringify(manifest));if(process.env.H4014_CAPTURE_DIR)await writeFile(process.env.H4014_CAPTURE_DIR+'/f06-immutable.json',JSON.stringify(manifest,null,2)+'\n');
});
test('A12 official advisors on current49 loopback full stdout/stderr/status',async()=>{
 const args=['--yes','supabase@2.119.0','db','advisors','--db-url','postgresql://crm_h0_migration@127.0.0.1:57210/crm_f06_authority?sslmode=disable','--type','all','--fail-on','error'];const r=spawnSync('npx',args,{encoding:'utf8',timeout:45000});const status={cmd:'npx',args,status:r.status,signal:r.signal,error:r.error?.message??null};console.log('F06 current49 advisors',JSON.stringify({stdout:r.stdout,stderr:r.stderr,status}));if(process.env.H4014_CAPTURE_DIR){await writeFile(process.env.H4014_CAPTURE_DIR+'/f06-advisors.stdout.log',r.stdout??'');await writeFile(process.env.H4014_CAPTURE_DIR+'/f06-advisors.stderr.log',r.stderr??'');await writeFile(process.env.H4014_CAPTURE_DIR+'/f06-advisors.status.json',JSON.stringify(status,null,2)+'\n');}assert.equal(r.status,0);assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(r.stdout).results,[]);
});
